item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 29/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front is expected to move across the coast of Guangdong between Saturday night and Sunday morning, the weather will become cold over the region early next week. Under the influence of the associated winter monsoon, it will be cloudy, rainy and windy with weather remaining cold over the coast of southern China on the Lunar New Year's Eve and the Lunar New Year holidays.

Date/Month: 29/01 (Saturday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4, force 5 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Cool in the morning and at night. Brighter during the day. One or two rain patches at night.
Temp range: 16 - 19 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 30/01 (Sunday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Becoming cold. Mainly cloudy. A few rain patches at first. Sunny periods in the afternoon.
Temp range: 12 - 16 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
